content: Use .agents/skills/memory and ./skill memory for lightweight human-approved project memory; .claude/skills points to .agents/skills for Claude Code compatibility.
title: Memory skill and CLI

content: In this Nimloth VAGEN/verl checkout, the ordinary PPO trainer defaults to dp_actor with strategy=fsdp. Megatron is only selected by the separate ppo_megatron_trainer or an explicit actor strategy override, so default latent/action extraction work can prioritize FSDP first.
title: VAGEN PPO default actor strategy is FSDP

content: If multiple SSH retries fail during Nimloth remote work, treat it as a possible network problem, stop retrying, and ask the human to handle it.
title: SSH repeated failures imply possible network issue

content: When the human asks to query cluster resources, report each partition and each node's remaining GPU/CPU/memory, not only aggregate totals. Use experiments/navigation_baseline/slurm_gpu_resources.py when available.
title: Report per-node Slurm resources when asked

content: For future server-resource work, first submit a placeholder/hold job to reserve the target GPUs/nodes, then connect to the allocated node(s) for interactive operation; do not assume queried free resources will remain available.
title: Reserve server resources with placeholder jobs

content: For SFT2, do not treat full-trajectory/packed-forward Qwen-VL image prefixes as semantically equivalent to per-prefix forwards: vLLM prompt logprobs also differ for image prefixes while text prefixes match exactly.
title: Qwen-VL image prefix non-invariance reproduces in vLLM

content: SGLang (0.5.3.post3) has bugs in Nimloth VAGEN multinode PPO training; use actor_rollout_ref.rollout.name=vllm via vagen_rollout_vllm_cli.inc.sh. Prior sglang runs hit Ray/FSDP worker join failures and unstable rollout.
title: VAGEN baseline rollout: use vLLM not SGLang

content: After fixing WMImageDecoder so it can overfit one sample, full reconstruction from state_proj(Qwen <latent_state>) at SFT2 step1000 still produced blocky images; oracle reconstruction stayed near copy baseline, so diagnose latent/image information before extending the same decoder training.
title: Reconstruction latent bottleneck after decoder fix

content: Affected VAGEN validation code zipped asynchronously ordered recording_to_log() results with input-order metadata, corrupting data_source/env_seed/eval_set labels. Never pair affected dumps directly by reported seed. Fixed VAGEN lineages 192c35a (255 path) and ef851af (old 504 path) propagate reset-time env_id-to-input-index identity and merge fail-fast. Strict rerun jobs 481089/481090 each passed 120 exact keys with zero metadata mismatch. Old dumps still require diagnostic recovery and cannot regain exact seed labels.
title: VAGEN async validation metadata mispairing

content: For B1 SFT2, moving world8+GA8 to world16+GA8 doubles effective global batch and halves optimizer steps; GA4 restores batch/step count, but per-microbatch global SIGReg still sees about twice as many states. Treat world-size changes as fresh runs because checkpoint invariants include world_size, grad_accum, and train_micro_batches.
title: SFT2 world-size scaling changes optimizer and SIGReg semantics

content: Before launching a full preprocessing-cache job, request at least 64 CPU cores and verify both ReqTRES and AllocTRES. If the chosen partition or QoS cannot provide 64 cores, stop and tell the human instead of silently reducing the request.
title: Full cache jobs require at least 64 CPU cores

content: VAGEN-Lite/VERL may host Nimloth joint PPO only through explicit adapters: preserve the K16 decision-state/ValueHead critic semantics, bind rollout behavior evidence, and fail closed until guided sampling, replay, snapshot, and checkpoint ownership are connected; stock actor/critic PPO is not a drop-in replacement.
title: VAGEN-Lite cannot replace planner RL trainer

content: When a projected state trails a visual teacher, probe the exact same-generation hidden before training a hidden-only projector adapter. ID191 found hidden weaker than projected state for goal and lateral outcomes, so projector calibration cannot be assumed to recover the missing evidence.
title: Probe projector input before calibration
